'''Resinwood''' was a type of wood that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. It had a strong and sweet medicinal scent.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
